papers.title: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
papers.authors: Hengyuan Xu, Qixun Wang, Yiji Cheng, Miles Yang, Zhao Zhong, Wei Cheng, Xingjun Ma, Yu-gang Jiang
papers.tags: image generation, pose estimation
papers.affiliations: Fudan University, Hunyuan/Tencent, The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: WithEveryone是一个统一的框架，通过交错的身份与布局推理、结构化布局思维链（Layout CoT）和布局锚定的身份损失（LG-ID Loss），实现了最多十个参考身份的高质量群体图像生成，在身份相似度和减少复制粘贴伪影方面超越了GPT-Image 2等专有系统。

papers.title: Swift-Image: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
papers.authors: Taihang Hu, Zhao Wang, Zuan Gao, Tao Liu, Hao Yan, Zhengze Xu, Yuhang Yu, Yongchao Du, Xingjian Wang, Jun Zheng, Qinye Zhou, Zhengrui Chen, Chao Lin, Yefeng Shen, Zhengtao Wu, Ge Wu, Xiaoli Xu, Denghui Yang, Huayu Zhang, Mingzhou Zhang, Mengting Chen
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Group
papers.intro: Swift-Image提出了一套系统化的训练工程流水线（包括渐进式预训练、并行专家强化学习、多教师蒸馏、结构剪枝和少步蒸馏），在仅6B参数和243K GPU训练小时下实现了领先的统一图像生成与编辑性能，并提供了3B压缩变体和少步加速变体。

papers.title: DreamHand: Repurposing Video Diffusion Models for Occlusion-Robust Egocentric 3D Hand Motion Recovery
papers.authors: Yufei Liu, Xixi Wang, Hao Li, Ganlong Zhao, Kaitong Cai, Chengkai Jin, Chunxiao Liu, Jianbo Liu, Siyuan Huang, Xingang Pan, Hongsheng Li
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, video generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, ACE Robotics
papers.intro: DreamHand将预训练视频扩散模型重新定位为确定性几何编码器，通过单次前向传播提取遮挡和视野外手部的场景内容，结合双向时空解码器和基于射线的相机求解器，实现了无需外部检测器和测试时相机内参的遮挡鲁棒性第一人称3D双手运动恢复。

papers.title: Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention for Hierarchical Feature Modulation toward Anatomy-Agnostic Segmentation
papers.authors: Mosharof Hossain, Md Rabiul Islam, Limon Halder, Erchin Serpedin, Md Kamrul Hasan
papers.tags: medical image, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Khulna University of Engineering & Technology (KUET), Texas A&M University, Imperial College London
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种名为Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention (PCCA)的新型提示条件通道注意力机制，通过层级化地将语义提示集成到编码器-解码器分割网络中，实现了跨架构、跨模态和跨解剖目标的通用医学图像分割框架PROMISE-Net。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Workflow Analysis in Colorectal Surgery: A Multicentric, Cross-Procedural Development and Generalization Study
papers.authors: Pietro Mascagni, Julia Alekseenko, Pooja P Jain, Marta Goglia, Andrea Balla, Ludovica Baldari, Gianfranco Silecchia, Claudio Fiorillo, Vincenzo Tondolo, Salvador Morales-Conde, Luigi Boni, Sergio Alfieri, Nicolas Padoy
papers.tags: video segmentation, vision transformer, image classification
papers.affiliations: IHU Strasbourg, Strasbourg, France; Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, Italy; Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Rome, Italy; University of Strasbourg, CNRS, INSERM, ICube, UMR7357, France; Sapienza University of Rome, Italy; University Hospital Virgen Macarena, University of Sevilla, Seville, Spain; Fondazione IRCCS - Ca' Granda - Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico di Milano, Milan, Italy; Ospedale Isola Tiberina–Gemelli Isola, Rome, Italy
papers.intro: 本文提出AI-ColoWorkflow，一个结合微调DINOv3视觉Transformer和层次化多阶段时序卷积网络的深度学习模型，能够基于统一共识本体论自动识别微创结直肠手术的阶段和步骤，并证明在多中心、多术式数据上训练的单一模型在阶段识别上优于或至少不逊于中心/术式特定模型。

papers.title: DPC-Net: Dual-Prior Collaborative Network for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.authors: Zhaokun He, Kangbiao Shi, Axi Niu, Jian Jin, Peng Wu, Wei Dong, Qingsen Yan
papers.tags: diffusion model, multimodal learning, image generation
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Singapore Management University, Xi'an University of Architecture and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种双先验协同网络（DPC-Net），通过联合利用退化-语义耦合先验和低层视觉先验，在全合一图像恢复任务中实现了高质量、结构一致且语义连贯的图像重建。

papers.title: Feature Evolution and Migration during Vision Transformer Training
papers.authors: Joonas Järve, Halil Ibrahim Aysel, Tarun Khajuria, Meelis Kull
papers.tags: vision transformer, image classification, CLIP
papers.affiliations: University of Tartu
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的epoch-by-layer二维框架，用于追踪ViT训练过程中视觉特征的演化与迁移，揭示了特征迁移主要集中在训练早期、深层特征比浅层特征更早且更强烈地稳定等关键发现。

papers.title: ArmorOCR: Grounded Adversarial Visual Perception via Observation-Transferred Self-Distillation
papers.authors: Linhan Cao, Siyuan Li, Jun Lan, Liangbo He, Guannan Li, Xiaolei Huang, Jun Jia, Shuheng Zhou, Huijia Zhu, Weiqiang Wang, Wei Sun
papers.tags: multimodal learning, OCR, visual grounding, object detection
papers.affiliations: Ant Group, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, East China Normal University
papers.intro: 本文提出了AdvSpot——首个用于接地对抗性OCR感知评估的基准，以及ArmorOCR——一个两阶段训练框架，通过观察转移自蒸馏（OPSD）和任务条件GRPO强化学习，将变换揭示的感知信息内化到模型参数中，实现单次前向推理的鲁棒对抗性OCR感知。

papers.title: Flow Matching-Based PET Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Fumio Hashimoto, Ziqian Huang, Tatsuya Yokota, Kuang Gong
papers.tags: diffusion model, medical image, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Florida; Nagoya Institute of Technology; RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
papers.intro: 本文提出基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的PET图像重建方法，通过将流匹配生成先验与PET数据一致性约束在近似贝叶斯框架下分离，实现了高效、稳定且定量准确的PET图像重建。

papers.title: BeyondMasks: Evaluating Causal and Physical Consistency in Video Object Removal
papers.authors: Yigit Ekin, Enes Sanli, Aykut Erdem, Erkut Erdem, Aysegul Dundar
papers.tags: video segmentation, video generation, multimodal learning, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Bilkent University, Koç University, Hacettepe University, KUIS AI Center
papers.intro: 本文提出BeyondMasks基准数据集和CORE评估协议，将视频物体移除重新定义为因果场景一致性任务，通过配对视频和视觉语言模型评估，揭示现有方法在消除物体引发的物理后效应方面的系统性失败。

papers.title: Detecting Backdoors in Object Detection via Pre-NMS Prediction Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Longtian Wang, Zhengyu Zhao, Chenhao Lin, Le Yang, Shiwei Wang, Yuhan Zhi, Xiaofei Xie, Chao Shen
papers.tags: object detection, YOLO, image classification
papers.affiliations: 西安交通大学（Xi'an Jiaotong University）、新加坡管理大学（Singapore Management University）
papers.intro: 本文提出DistScan，一种基于pre-NMS预测类别分布偏移的后门检测框架，通过比较模型在干净输入上的中间预测类别分布与训练数据类别频率的JS散度来识别后门模型，无需触发器知识、模型权重访问或额外训练，在场景级攻击下显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
papers.authors: Changshun Wu, Weicheng He, Xiaowei Huang, Saddek Bensalem
papers.tags: object detection, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Liverpool, UK; Université Grenoble Alpes, France; CSX-AI, France
papers.intro: 本文提出结构化先验知识（SPK）框架，通过从预训练目标检测器中显式地引出语义、几何和上下文三类潜在先验，并将其组织为紧凑的五维表示空间，实现可解释且高性能的OoD幻觉检测。

papers.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Jihae Jeong, Junha Choi, Hwanjo Yu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image captioning, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)
papers.intro: ReWEIGH是一种无需训练的推理时解码干预方法，通过将视觉token状态的词汇排名聚合为稠密平均倒数排名（DMRR）证据，并与从无标注图像估计的token特定参考值进行比较，对证据不足的候选词施加有界惩罚，从而有效减少LVLM的幻觉。

papers.title: LT-Mem: Volatility-Aware Spatio-Temporal Memory for Lifelong Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Yumin Lee, Hyoseok Ju, Giseop Kim
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Department of Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering, DGIST, Daegu, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: LT-Mem提出了一种波动性感知（volatility-aware）的记忆演化框架，通过将空间对齐的实例级3D感知与波动性条件化的时序推理相结合，构建Live、Delta、Meta三重复合记忆结构，在保持当前状态的同时保留事件历史，从而支持跨会话的纵向对象中心推理和时序问答。

papers.title: USR-Drive: Unified Driving Scene Representation via Joint Denoising of 3D Gaussians and Boxes
papers.authors: Li-Heng Chen, Haokai Pang, Chengye Su, Jiarun Liu, Qifeng Chen, Ziqian Ni, Jianxin Huang, Shi-Sheng Huang, Hongbo Fu, Sheng Yang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, object detection, autonomous driving, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: NIO, HKUST, Beijing Normal University
papers.intro: USR-Drive提出一个统一的条件生成框架，通过多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）在共享的度量时空坐标系中联合去噪3D高斯密集几何令牌和3D边界框稀疏布局令牌，实现动态驾驶场景重建与3D检测的相互增强。

papers.title: Autonomous Agricultural Tractor: Integrated Weed Detection and LiDAR Navigation for Precision Paddy Farming
papers.authors: Benjamin Merryman-Smith, Tony Nguyen, Bilal Dogutas, Krish Shah, Anthony Raphael, Sudip Dhakal
papers.tags: object detection, autonomous driving, LiDAR, semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Department of Computing and Software Engineering, Florida Gulf Coast University, Fort Myers, FL 33965, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出AgriNav——一个集成的自主水稻田拖拉机系统，通过四个ROS耦合模块（WeedDet水稻检测、轻量级CNN-FPN变体、倒置逻辑判别模块和6状态EKF定位）以及一个零额外硬件成本的四机制LiDAR-相机融合桥，同时解决冠层下GNSS退化导航、实时水稻-杂草视觉判别和不对称误分类代价三个挑…

papers.title: Mise-en-Scène: Implicit Layout Emergence in Diffusion Transformers for Human-AI Design Co-Creation
papers.authors: Zipeng Xu, Ryan Murdock, Umberto Michieli
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Canva Research
papers.intro: 本文提出Mise-en-Scène框架，通过仅用小型knockout-selected LoRA适配预训练图像编辑扩散Transformer，让布局在扩散模型的联合注意力流中隐式涌现，再通过确定性匹配-放置后处理保证素材像素级保真，实现元素条件化的图形设计生成。

papers.title: GrabVG: Graph-Attentive Binding for Visual Grounding in UAV Imagery
papers.authors: Chaowei Wang, Yan Di, Jingjun Sun, Baozhe Liu, Jiaxu Tian, Yuheng Li, Guangqian Guo, Shan Gao
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, multimodal learning, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Harbin Institute of Technology, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: GrabVG提出了一种受人类视觉搜索机制启发的无人机视觉定位框架，通过将定位过程显式分解为"前注意假设搜索"和"图注意力特征绑定"两个阶段，在稀疏候选图上进行语言引导的外观绑定和拓扑关系推理，从而在拥挤的无人机场景中实现准确高效的目标定位。

papers.title: ForeSightGuide: An Anticipatory Framework toward Accurate and Low-Redundancy Guidance for the Visually Impaired
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Wang, Xu Li, Shikang Guo, Wei Meng, Quan Liu, Jie Zuo
papers.tags: object detection, autonomous driving, BEV perception, YOLO
papers.affiliations: School of Information Engineering, Wuhan University of Technology
papers.intro: ForeSightGuide提出了一种面向视障人士的预测性辅助导航框架，通过结合历史视觉观测预测障碍物运动趋势、构建预测性鸟瞰图（BEV）并进行威胁评估过滤，在保持低漏报率的同时显著减少冗余警报，实现高精度、低认知负荷的安全行走辅助。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Art-Historical Dating with Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Stefanie Schneider, Peter Bell
papers.tags: image classification
papers.affiliations: Marburg University, Biegenstraße 11, 35037 Marburg, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种不确定性感知的艺术作品日期估计方法，通过分位数回归与分裂共形校准相结合，在冻结的预训练视觉嵌入上生成校准的时间区间，并引入"时间纠缠"框架来诊断预训练视觉语言模型编码的时间信号与机构数据条件之间的偏差。
